power_contract.battery_holder_profile: Keystone Electronics 1048P is the exact prototype and production-reference holder: dual open SMT, mechanically polarized before contact, 86.0x39.8 mm, and intended for longer protected 18650 cells. The base product qualifies only exact protected button-top cell MPNs; raw flat-top cells are unsupported. Four physically separate slot contacts are routed independently and require specimen continuity/orientation proof before footprint freeze
power_contract.battery_cell_profile: Two separately replaceable exact XTAR 18650 4000mAh protected button-top cells are the first qualification target. Each is 3.6V nominal, 4000mAh typical/3800mAh minimum, <=40mOhm initial resistance, 10A maximum continuous discharge, 2A standard/4A maximum charge, and 11-14A protection trip, with a maximum 18.7x69.7-mm envelope. The 2S pair is 28.8Wh nominal and retains the 6.0-8.4V product window. Only manufacturer or authorized regional-kit supply with exact assembly transport/safety evidence is admitted; missing UN38.3 test-summary identity, counterfeit evidence, mixed MPN/lot/age/SOC or failed specimen HIL remains disconnected
power_contract.battery_thermal_coupling: PACK_NTC0 and PACK_NTC1 each use a dedicated electrically insulated compliant contact through an open holder window to the middle third of their own cell can. The independent BQ25798 TS NTC uses one of two indexed physical tongue locations and is populated on the thermally worst slot after placement analysis. Open/short/lifted contact blocks admission or charge; compression, insulation, response time and replacement-cycle HIL remain mandatory
power_contract.battery_manager: MAX17320G20+T 2S gauge/protector plus independently recoverable MSPM0C1104SDGS20R admission controller; G20 is I2C without SHA-256; blank/wrong gauge NVM or reset/watchdog MCU remains fail-closed
power_contract.battery_recovery_policy: base product refuses any cell below the qualified admission floor; MAX17320 zero-volt charge and linear prequal are disabled; any research recovery uses a separate isolated Controlled-Zone fixture
power_contract.manager_power_path: one active CSD87313DMST common-drain package provides the fully-switching CHG/DIS pair required by MAX17320; two 0451005.MRL slot fuses, WSL25125L000FEA 5mOhm shunt and two B57332V5103F360 cell NTCs are exact first targets
power_contract.manager_supply: MAX17320 AOLDO and isolated fixture enter BAV70LT1G; admitted system 3V3 enters BAT54-7-F and wins by lower drop; 2N7002DW-7-F asserts ALRT hold during MCU reset; source handover and current remain HIL gates

power_contract.application_rails: three independent TPS564252DRLR channels generate raw 3.3/4.0/5.0-V rails. power_contract.rail_inductors: MWSA0503S-3R3MT is the exact first target for 3V3_MAIN and VVOICE_4V; MWSA0503S-4R7MT is the exact first target for 5V_EXT

Each TPS564252 uses one GRM32ER71E226KE15L plus one C1005X7R1H104K050BB at VIN, two independent GRM32ER71E226KE15L output capacitors and one C0402C330J5GACTU feed-forward capacitor. power_contract.quiet_switches: independent TPS22919DCKR instances gate the nRF group, CC1101, microSD, ES8311 and Si4732 branches with reset-off ON pulls and qualified QOD discharge
power_contract.switched_pg_qualification: separate MMBT3904-7-F stages qualify protected voice eFuse PG and protected accessory converter/eFuse evidence with their STOP-dominant EN requests; only EN high plus PG low at the protected rail may pull POWER_FAULT_N low, so a normally disabled rail is not a fault. Raw main and voice converter PG contacts remain diagnostic test points and cannot falsely certify the load side of a tripped post-buck eFuse
power_contract.converter_control_passive_profile: Ten physical resistor positions close converter control after DEC-0080. TPS629203 EN is tied directly to admitted SYS and its PG has one RC0402FR-0747KL pull-up to AON_SAFE_3V3. TPS564252 optional EN defaults use one RC0402FR-0710KL for voice and accessory; the main EN fail-low is RC0402FR-07100KL so the 10-kOhm open-drain POR pull-up releases it to about 3.0V rather than a marginal 1.65V. POWER_FAULT_N has one RC0402FR-0710KL pull-up; voice and accessory PG each have their own RC0402FR-0710KL pull-up. Each MMBT3904 qualifier base uses one RC0402FR-0768KL series resistor
power_contract.source_sequence_profile: No separate programmable source-admission sequencer exists. Valid battery admission or protected USB power creates BQ25798 SYS; SYS starts TPS629203 in hardware. Its pulled-up AON_PG_N directly drives TPS3808G33 MR_N. The supervisor then requires both its 3.07-V SENSE threshold and AON PG, applies the exact CT delay, and releases open-drain POR_N. One exact RC0402FR-0710KL pulls POR_N to AON_SAFE_3V3 and the existing RC0402FR-07100KL pulls MAIN_3V3_EN low, producing about 3.0V at release and forcing main off on AON PG/SENSE loss without firmware
power_contract.internal_rail_protection_profile: TPS25961DRVR lies between AON_RAW_3V3 and AON_SAFE_3V3 with RC0402FR-07240KL nominal 0.208-A current limit, RC0402FR-07196KL/RC0402FR-07100KL 3.505-3.809-V OVLO corner window, one local 100-nF input capacitor and one 10-uF protected output capacitor. Main and voice each use latch-off circuit-breaker TPS25974LRPWR, 4.7-nF controlled rise, 120-pF approximately 0.09-ms transient blanking and protected-rail PG. Main uses a 1.65-kOhm 3.2-3.715-A threshold, precision 191/100-kOhm 3.438-3.578-V OVLO window and 45.3/30-kOhm PG divider. Voice uses a 3.32-kOhm 1.55-1.905-A threshold, 270/100-kOhm 4.314-4.610-V OVLO window and 68/33-kOhm PG divider. Every EN/UVLO is tied to its own sub-5-V raw rail; firmware cannot bypass OVLO, overcurrent, short or thermal shutdown

power_contract.diagnostic_load_profile: Two parallel CRM2512-FX-20R0ELF pulse-rated 20-ohm/2-W resistors form an exact 10-ohm 4-W load ahead of a DMN2056U-7 low-side switch across the fused 2S stack. PA22 emits only a rising edge into non-retriggerable TPUL2G223BQBR channel 1; exact 169-kOhm/220-nF C0G timing gives about 34.4 ms typical and a conservative 28.7-40.7 ms paper range, with production accepting only 25-50 ms. At the end of every channel-1 pulse, its falling Q edge starts channel 2. Exact 620-kOhm/1-uF timing holds complementary 2Q low for a paper minimum of 350 ms and asynchronously clears channel 1, so a stuck or hostile MCU can produce at most one bounded pulse per refractory interval. The two load resistors remain below their combined hot derated continuous rating even under that hardware-only worst case; firmware imposes a longer HIL-derived operational cooldown
power_contract.admission_adc_profile: MSPM0 internal 1.4-V reference measures midpoint on PA25/A2 through 2x220-kOhm over 169-kOhm plus 10-nF and full stack on PA26/A1 through 5x220-kOhm over 169-kOhm plus 10-nF. At 4.3/8.6-V fault-screen maxima and 1% resistor corners, ADC inputs remain below 1.21/1.17 V. PA24/A3 is released because the exact MSPM0C1104 datasheet forbids injection current on that physical contact
power_contract.charger_passive_profile: BQ25798 is physically strapped for 2S at 750kHz by RC0402FR-078K2L and MWSA0503S-2R2MT. Twelve independent GRM31CR71E106MA12L bulk capacitors, three C1005X7R1H104K050BB HF capacitors, two GRM155R71E473KA88D bootstrap capacitors, one CGA5L1X7R1E475K160AC REGN capacitor and one C0402C102K5RACTU SDRV capacitor implement the no-ship-FET/no-backup path. A 44.2k/100k ILIM divider bounds the physical input target to about 2.71-3.29A over REGN and resistor corners; negotiated IINDPM is always the lower limit. B57332V5103F360 plus 5.23k/30.1k provides a direct non-ignored charger TS gate; shared local-bus SCL/SDA use exact 2.2-kOhm TPS-LDO pull-ups, INT uses 10 kOhm, and reset-high CE pulls to REGN while TPS GPIO1 acts as an open-drain enable
power_contract.pd_support_profile: TPS25751D hardware SafeMode straps ADCIN1 high and ADCIN2 low for target address 0x20. Raw USB VBUS feeds both VBUS and VBUS_IN; PP5V is grounded for sink-only operation. VIN_3V3 uses AON_SAFE_3V3 after autonomous dead-battery startup. Exact 10-uF VIN/LDO capacitors, 4.7-uF VBUS, four 22-uF PPHV capacitors, 220-pF C0G per protected CC, EEPROM bypass/WP pull-up, 2.2-kOhm local and host I2C pull-ups and a 10-kOhm host IRQ pull-up complete the paper circuit. EEPROM address straps are low; GPIO0 is open-drain and may sink WP only in an authorized signed-update window; every unused TPS GPIO is grounded
power_contract.product_usb_profile: JAE DX07S016JA1R1500 terminates the product port. A single TI TPD4S201RUKR protects connector-side CC1/CC2 and repurposes its two explicitly USB2-capable SBU channels for D+/D-, adding 28-V short-to-VBUS and IEC ESD isolation before TPS25751D and S3. Two exact 22-Ohm series resistors at S3 follow the Espressif initial USB Full-Speed RC recommendation; two 0402 shunt-capacitor positions are reserved DNP and therefore are not BOM instances until measured tuning requires them. RPD_G1/G2 loop to connector-side CC for dead-battery attach. VPWR uses TPS LDO_3V3 with an exact 1-uF capacitor; VBIAS uses an exact 100-nF/100-V capacitor. FLT has a 10-kOhm LDO_3V3 pull-up and protected test point without consuming a GPIO. Two exact 220-pF C0G CC shunts replace 330 pF so TPS 120-pF input plus 40-120-pF protector and capacitor tolerance remain at 369-471 pF before route parasitics, leaving 129 pF to the USB-PD 600-pF ceiling. SBU and Alt Mode are unsupported; VBUS remains on the existing TVS2200/TPS sink-only path
power_contract.external_protection: TPS259470LRPWR follows the 5V converter and provides always-on reverse blocking, latch-off thermal-fault behavior and open-drain fault evidence. RC0402FR-072K21L sets a nominal 1.509A current limit that applies immediately at startup; GRM155R71H472KA01D limits the controlled startup slew. GRM188R71E224KA88D permits only a bounded post-start 2A transient; it does not defer startup current limiting. The exact OVLO divider, local capacitors and passive output bleeder complete the accepted paper profile
